ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.
   C. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapters 90:1? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapters 90:1.

   D. Say Selected Chapters 90:1 has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.

   C. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
